steps.title: Fetch the FasTag home vehicle listing from the backend
steps.notes: Live-verified 10 Aug 2026 (WE25622, production): HTTP 200, api.success=true, api.componentData.list.0.vehicleNumber=UP11Q1112. No literal 'api.success == true' assertion string -- assertions[] only does literal on-screen substring matching (comparators only work inside a step's 'when' predicate, per compilePlan SKILL.md); the call-api action itself already fails the step on a non-2xx/non-success response (expectStatus default: any 2xx), same convention as gpsListingFlow.plan.json's own call-api steps (assertions: []).

steps.title: First IDFC vehicle from the API is present somewhere in the IDFC list
steps.notes: Re-verified live 10 Aug 2026 (WE25622): api.componentData.list.0.vehicleNumber resolved to UP11Q1112, not visible on screen without scrolling (NOT FOUND via plain contains beforehand). scroll-to (down, in the IDFC FASTags section) found it after exactly 2 scrolls -- same count as the prior pass, confirming this is stable. The backend's pageNo=1 list order does not match the UI's render order; presence, not first-card position, is what this step checks.
